description: Check every workspace file (and every member of a ZIP) for an API key or credential: the value of any key this server can find, key-shaped assignments and URL parameters, and for sources that echo keys any 32-hex token. Lists file names and line numbers only, never values. Both audits run it too.

sources.description: Source ids used (default: the data/<id>/ folders)

title: Scan for keys
